mintAuthority.summary: stUSDS is an ERC-4626 risk-capital wrapper over USDS; wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting while durable USDS mint authority is inherited from reviewed Sky governance controls.

controls.label: stUSDS ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573289, asset() returned USDS 0xdC035D45d973E3EC169d2276DDab16f1e407384F. The UUPS implementation slot resolved to 0x7A61B7adCFD493f7CF0F86dFCECB94b72c227F22 while the EIP-1967 admin and beacon slots were zero. Current wrapper shares are created against USDS deposits and do not create durable USDS supply.

controls.label: stUSDS Sky Pause Proxy upgrade authority
controls.capDescription: The Sky governance executor is warded on the UUPS wrapper and can authorize an implementation that changes local share-mint logic after the Sky Pause delay.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573289, stUSDS.wards(0xBE8E3e3618f7474F8cB1d074A26afFef007E98FB) returned 1. PauseProxy.owner() returned DSPause 0xbE286431454714F511008713973d3B053A2d38f3, whose delay() returned 172800 seconds. The proxy reported UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION 5.0.0, and the pinned implementation source gates _authorizeUpgrade with the wards-based auth modifier.

upgradeability.controlRef: stUSDS Sky Pause Proxy upgrade authority

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-20 at Ethereum block 25573289. asset() confirms that stUSDS wraps USDS. Its EIP-1967 implementation slot resolves to 0x7a61b7adcfd493f7cf0f86dfcecb94b72c227f22 with zero external admin and beacon slots, and the proxy reports UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION 5.0.0. stUSDS.wards(Sky Pause Proxy 0xBE8E3e3618f7474F8cB1d074A26afFef007E98FB) is 1; PauseProxy.owner() resolves to DSPause 0xbE286431454714F511008713973d3B053A2d38f3, whose delay() is 172800 seconds. The pinned implementation source makes UUPS authorization wards-gated, so this delayed governance path can replace local logic; current public share minting remains USDS-deposit backed. No independent wrapper reserve reconciliation or named prudential supervisor is established.
